title: Second meeting: implants, not ganglion

tellings.quote: We did. And he he they said implants >> and it was it was more technological uh some kind of implants.

plain: In 1996, at the Los Angeles offices of Dark Skies, a television series about UFOs, a second meeting with outside visitors turned on the idea of alien implants, something technological, rather than an earlier idea involving a ganglion, a cluster of nerve cells. A television writer named Bryce Zabel tells Michels this as someone who was in the room, naming the visitors only as JC and "the captain".
